build_context_archive.format: sorted USTAR, uid/gid/mtime=0, mode=0644, gzip mtime=0
build_context_archive.scope: Explicit Docker build context allowlist; source Python files, entrypoint, Dockerfile, requirements, LICENSE, NOTICE, .dockerignore. Excludes configuration, credentials, VCS, tests and documentation.

limitations: This records one resolved image and scan snapshot, not bit-for-bit reproducibility or a guarantee against unknown vulnerabilities.
Runtime Python dependency versions are pinned; requirements are not yet a wheel/hash lock.
Alpine build repositories remain mutable. License inventory includes OS and Python components with licenses distinct from this project MIT license.
